answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the whisper graph and each risks its bond. Because the cedar release is recorded with every signature, the saffron audit makes public the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 4 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. That is 38 dollars per alias.
